config.name: cardiac_temporal_balanced_v2
config.scope: one pressure trajectory and one fixed geometry; contiguous time holdout is not independent geometry/trajectory validation
config.prediction: POD correction to old acceleration, then exact Newmark displacement update; causal u/v/a histories and prescribed next load as inputs
config.supervision: displacement correction MSE scaled by training correction variance, equivalent to supervised acceleration-increment MSE under fixed dt
config.rollout: start from exact state at test boundary and recursively update predicted u/v/a; report invalid Jacobians or nonfinite predictions as failures
config.lambda_grid_reason: training-only median data/physics parameter-gradient norm ratio, rounded to decade; one decade below/above
config.evaluation_scope: same temporal test already evaluated by earlier pilot; repeated exploratory temporal evaluation, not confirmatory
